payout_quote: The Referred Person acknowledges that a $100 Mastercard Reward Card will be issued to the Referrer after all conditions have been met within the required time frames.
steps: Be a Regent Bank customer eligible to refer
Send your friend the referral email/social-media link through ReferLive
Friend registers via your link and opens a new Regent Bank personal checking account
Friend completes two (2) direct deposits of at least $500 each within 60 days of account opening
Friend keeps the account open for 60 days
Your $100 Mastercard Reward Card is issued 4-6 weeks after all requirements are completed
catches: Direct deposits must be real payroll/government/retirement payments; Zelle, internal transfers, ATM, and mobile deposits do not count
Friend must keep the account open 60 days
Referral must start via your referral email or social link — friend must register through ReferLive
Card delivery 4-6 weeks after completion; reward cards may be reported as income to the IRS
No referral cap stated; offer effective 07/06/2026 and may end at any time
biggest_catch: Your friend gets $200 — double your $100 — and your payout only comes after their two $500 direct deposits clear and the account stays open 60 days.
eligibility: Regent Bank customers (employees ineligible); referred friends open new personal checking
timing: Card issued 4-6 weeks after all conditions are met
